A number with minus and plus buttons; a fractional step keeps its decimals, min and max stop the buttons.

From 1 to 10.
step="0.25" keeps two decimals.
step="100".
Sizes: number-input-sm, default, number-input-lg.

One-time code

The OTP input of Bootstrap 6: one field drawn as a slot per character; a pasted code fills all of them.

Six digits.
otp-connected joins the slots into one field.
data-bs-groups="[3,3]".
Four slots by maxlength="4", hidden by data-bs-mask="true".
data-bs-type="alphanumeric".
The code is right.
The code has six digits.
Sizes: otp-sm, default, otp-lg.

Datepicker

The calendar of Bootstrap 6 under an input: an ISO date for the server, or the date in the language of the page.

The value is an ISO date.
From today, written in Czech.
A date with a time.
A range over two months.
